other_conditions: Candidate must not be a recipient of any Central Government, State Government, or AICTE sponsored scholarships.
Candidate must be currently enrolled in an AICTE approved institution pursuing a degree or diploma in regular mode (1st to 4th year).
Eligibility category noted in source: orphan
Eligibility category noted in source: parents died due to Covid-19
Eligibility category noted in source: ward of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred
benefits_summary: Provides a scholarship of Rs. 50,000 per annum for up to 4 years for degree students and up to 3 years for diploma students.
